classification: A. PARAMETERIZATION CONFLICT IDENTIFIED - ONE NATURAL CHALLENGER JUSTIFIED
why_not_full_domain_endpoint_issue: Historical developmental-RB source-percentile support spans ~0.003 to ~0.997. The constraint bound because it ordered correction multipliers, not because only unsupported endpoints caused crossing.
why_not_non_actionable: The feasibility contrast remains temporally stable and the unconstrained exact objective can express differential slopes without causing any historical final-state ordering violation.
additional_mechanism: The tested challenger fit raw log(target/D1_mean) residuals in-sample, whereas the feasibility signal was established on prospective walk-forward log1p residuals. On canonical out-of-sample rows the lower group is below D1; on in-sample raw-log-ratio fitting inputs the lower group has a strongly positive level. That mismatch pushes the unconstrained fit toward M_L>M_U.
